{{Top|leg}}
'''Ronto barbecue steak''' was a type of [[Steak/Legends|steak]] served by [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] vendors in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Made from [[Ronto/Legends|rontos]], the steaks were often the target of theft by [[Falk (criminal)|Falk]] and [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]] when they were young.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
